parts.zh: W：听着，保罗，我很抱歉周五这个时候来打扰你
W：保罗，我不会耽误你太久
W：嗯，你也知道，印度有发生动乱的报道
M：而且这还会影响到我们
W：所以我想，采取远期外汇保值来保护我们未完成合同中的利益

items.stem: What do we learn about the man's daily life?

choices.text: He cooks dinner for the family occasionally.
choices.zh: 他偶尔为家人做晚餐。

choices.text: He dines out from time to time with friends.
choices.zh: 他不时和朋友外出就餐。

choices.text: He shares some of the household duties.
choices.zh: 他分担一些家务。

choices.text: He often goes back home late for dinner.
choices.zh: 他经常很晚回家吃晚餐。

items.stem: Why did the woman come to see the man?

choices.text: To take him to dinner.
choices.zh: 带他去吃晚餐。

choices.text: To discuss an urgent problem.
choices.zh: 讨论一个紧急问题。

choices.text: To talk about a budget plan.
choices.zh: 谈论一项预算计划。

choices.text: To pass on an important message.
choices.zh: 传达一条重要信息。

items.stem: What makes the woman worry about the Indian rupee?

choices.text: Foreign investors are losing confidence in India's economy.
choices.zh: 外国投资者正在失去对印度经济的信心。

choices.text: Many multinational enterprises are withdrawing from India.
choices.zh: 许多跨国企业正在从印度撤出。

choices.text: There is a sharp increase in India's balance of payment deficit.
choices.zh: 印度的国际收支逆差急剧增加。

choices.text: There are wild fluctuations in the international money market.
choices.zh: 国际货币市场出现剧烈波动。

items.stem: What can we infer from the conversation?

choices.text: JL Motors is a company with the business of bicycle sales.
choices.zh: JL Motors是一家经营自行车销售业务的公司。

choices.text: The Indian rupee has been steady on the foreign exchange market.
choices.zh: 印度卢比在外汇市场上一直保持稳定。

choices.text: JL Motors is an Indian company with a promising prospect.
choices.zh: JL Motors是一家前景看好的印度公司。

choices.text: The man doesn't agree to the woman's proposal.
choices.zh: 这位男士不同意这位女士的提议。

items.stem: What does the man say about most people when they get into love affairs?

choices.text: They try to adapt to their changing roles.
choices.zh: 他们试图适应不断变化的角色。

choices.text: They form a more realistic picture of life.
choices.zh: 他们对生活形成更现实的认识。

choices.text: They may not be prepared for a lifelong relationship.
choices.zh: 他们可能没有为终身关系做好准备。

choices.text: They have unrealistic expectations about the other half.
choices.zh: 他们对另一半抱有不切实际的期望。

items.stem: What does the man say about himself as a singer on the road most of his life?

choices.text: He is lucky to be able to do what he loves.
choices.zh: 他很幸运能够做自己热爱的事情。

choices.text: He is able to meet many interesting people.
choices.zh: 他能够结识许多有趣的人。

choices.text: He is able to forget all the troubles in his life.
choices.zh: 他能够忘记生活中的所有烦恼。

choices.text: He is lucky to have visited many exotic places.
choices.zh: 他很幸运游览过许多异国他乡。

items.stem: What do most people think of the life of a famous musician?

choices.text: It is stressful.
choices.zh: 充满压力。

choices.text: It is all glamour.
choices.zh: 全是光鲜亮丽。

choices.text: It is full of fun.
choices.zh: 充满乐趣。

choices.text: It is challenging.
choices.zh: 富有挑战性。

items.stem: How does the man feel whenever he is recognized by his fans?

choices.text: Amazed.
choices.zh: 惊讶。

choices.text: Bothered.
choices.zh: 困扰。

choices.text: Puzzled.
choices.zh: 困惑。

choices.text: Excited.
choices.zh: 兴奋。

items.stem: What should team members do to fully realize their potential?

choices.text: Learn to be respectful in a hierarchical organization.
choices.zh: 学会在等级制组织中尊重他人。

choices.text: Follow closely the fast development of technology.
choices.zh: 密切跟随技术的快速发展。

choices.text: Learn new ways of relating and working together.
choices.zh: 学习新的相处和协作方式。

choices.text: Maintain the traditional organizational culture.
choices.zh: 维持传统的组织文化。

items.stem: What needs to be considered for effective team management?

choices.text: How the team is built to keep improving its performance.
choices.zh: 如何建设团队以持续提升其绩效。

choices.text: What type of personnel the team should be composed of.
choices.zh: 团队应该由什么类型的人员组成。

choices.text: How the team integrates with what it is supposed to serve.
choices.zh: 团队如何与其服务对象相整合。

choices.text: What qualifications team members should be equipped with.
choices.zh: 团队成员应该具备什么资质。

items.stem: What conclusion can we draw from what Casey says?

choices.text: A team manager must set very clear and high objectives.
choices.zh: 团队管理者必须设定非常明确和高的目标。

choices.text: Teams must consist of members from different cultures.
choices.zh: 团队必须由来自不同文化的成员组成。

choices.text: Team members should be knowledgeable and creative.
choices.zh: 团队成员应该知识渊博且富有创造力。

choices.text: A team manager should develop a certain set of skills.
choices.zh: 团队管理者应该培养一套特定的技能。

items.stem: What is probably the best form of advertising according to the speaker?

choices.text: Word-of-mouth advertising.
choices.zh: 口碑广告。

choices.text: Distributing free trial products.
choices.zh: 分发免费试用产品。

choices.text: Prestige advertising.
choices.zh: 声望广告。

choices.text: Institutional advertising.
choices.zh: 机构广告。

items.stem: What does the speaker say is the purpose of many organizations using prestige advertising?

choices.text: To sell a particular product.
choices.zh: 销售某一特定产品。

choices.text: To attract high-end consumers.
choices.zh: 吸引高端消费者。

choices.text: To promote a specific service.
choices.zh: 推广某一特定服务。

choices.text: To build up their reputation.
choices.zh: 树立自身声誉。

items.stem: How do large companies generally handle their advertising?

choices.text: By creating their own ads and commercials.
choices.zh: 自行创作广告和商业广告片。

choices.text: By buying media space in leading newspapers.
choices.zh: 在主流报纸购买媒体版面。

choices.text: By hiring their own professional advertising staff.
choices.zh: 聘用自己的专业广告人员。

choices.text: By using the services of large advertising agencies.
choices.zh: 使用大型广告代理公司的服务。

items.stem: What will advertising agencies often do before a national campaign?

choices.text: Conduct a large-scale survey on customer needs.
choices.zh: 就顾客需求进行大规模调查。

choices.text: Specify the objectives of the campaign in detail.
choices.zh: 详细说明宣传活动的目标。

choices.text: Pre-test alternative ads or commercials in certain regions.
choices.zh: 在特定地区预先测试备选广告或商业广告片。

choices.text: Decide on what specific means of communication to employ.
choices.zh: 决定采用何种具体的传播手段。

items.stem: According to Dr. Wood, what is essential to forming a good family atmosphere?

choices.text: The effective communication among family members.
choices.zh: 家庭成员之间的有效沟通。

choices.text: The principle of "avoid adding trouble to others".
choices.zh: "避免给他人添麻烦"的原则。

choices.text: The mutual love and caring between parents and children.
choices.zh: 父母与子女之间的相互关爱和关心。

choices.text: Everyone's commitment to support each other.
choices.zh: 每个人相互支持的承诺。

items.stem: Which of the following is helpful for minimizing outside distractions during communication?

choices.text: Thinking before speaking.
choices.zh: 说话前先思考。

choices.text: Adopting empathy during communication.
choices.zh: 在沟通中采用共情。

choices.text: Focusing on the present.
choices.zh: 专注于当下。

choices.text: Listening attentively.
choices.zh: 专心倾听。

items.stem: Which of the following should be avoided in order to make a conversation smooth?

choices.text: Adopting nonverbal signals.
choices.zh: 采用非语言信号。

choices.text: Being aggressive or overly stressed.
choices.zh: 表现得咄咄逼人或过度紧张。

choices.text: Maintaining eye contact to show attentiveness.
choices.zh: 保持眼神接触以表现专注。

choices.text: Keeping a suitable distance and respecting personal space.
choices.zh: 保持适当距离并尊重个人空间。

items.stem: What is essential to be a good listener?

choices.text: To make sure you turn off your cell phones.
choices.zh: 确保关闭手机。

choices.text: To respect people involved in the conversation.
choices.zh: 尊重参与对话的人。

choices.text: To show you are an easy-going person.
choices.zh: 表现出你是一个随和的人。

choices.text: To offer suggestions actively.
choices.zh: 积极提供建议。

items.stem: Among human's various abilities, which one has the same mechanism as mental health?

choices.text: The ability of speaking a certain kind of language.
choices.zh: 说某种语言的能力。

choices.text: The ability of mending things.
choices.zh: 修理东西的能力。

choices.text: The ability of building a good relationship.
choices.zh: 建立良好关系的能力。

choices.text: The ability of healing physical wounds.
choices.zh: 愈合身体伤口的能力。

items.stem: Among the following mental statuses, which can be the indication of possessing mental health?

choices.text: Always feeling miserable when encountering difficulties.
choices.zh: 遇到困难时总是感到痛苦。

choices.text: Keeping calm though the child has made the house a mess.
choices.zh: 尽管孩子把房子弄得一团糟仍保持冷静。

choices.text: Unwilling to offer a hand to those in troubles.
choices.zh: 不愿意向处于困境中的人伸出援手。

choices.text: Feeling superior to everybody else.
choices.zh: 感觉自己优越于其他所有人。

items.stem: Which of the following is the best title for this passage?

choices.text: Mental Health: Tool Case of the Mind
choices.zh: 心理健康:心智的工具箱

choices.text: How to Gain Mental Health
choices.zh: 如何获得心理健康

choices.text: Mental Health: The Key to Success
choices.zh: 心理健康:成功的关键

choices.text: Be Careful of Mental Problems
choices.zh: 小心心理问题

items.stem: What is the fundamental step of career planning?

choices.text: Studying hard for a relatively high degree.
choices.zh: 努力学习以获得相对较高的学位。

choices.text: Having enough knowledge about different careers.
choices.zh: 对不同职业有足够的了解。

choices.text: Understanding the new trend of career planning.
choices.zh: 理解职业规划的新趋势。

choices.text: Knowing more about yourself.
choices.zh: 更多地了解你自己。

items.stem: According to the speaker, what should you do if your ultimate aim is rather ambitious?

choices.text: Ask for professional advice from experienced people.
choices.zh: 向有经验的人寻求专业建议。

choices.text: Bring it down to a practical level.
choices.zh: 将它降到一个切实可行的水平。

choices.text: Divide it into smaller and achievable goals.
choices.zh: 将它分解成更小的、可实现的目标。

choices.text: Find an objective standard to reevaluate your ability.
choices.zh: 找到一个客观标准来重新评估你的能力。

items.stem: What is the meaning of making career plans?

choices.text: To help you to deal with new problems you may meet with in your career better.
choices.zh: 帮助你更好地处理职业生涯中可能遇到的新问题。

choices.text: To ensure that you achieve something big sometime in the future.
choices.zh: 确保你在未来某个时候取得重大成就。

choices.text: To shorten the time you are tangled up with tricky situations.
choices.zh: 缩短你被棘手情况困扰的时间。

choices.text: To accelerate the process of climbing up the social ladder.
choices.zh: 加快攀登社会阶梯的进程。
